{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Cigarra.jpg|thumb|right|A member of [[Arns Grimraker]]'s [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] smokes a cigarra.]]
{{Quote|Thank you, but... well, whatever it is you do with those, I ''don't''.|[[Wynn Dorvan]] declining [[Booster Terrik]]'s offer of a cigar before the [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]]|<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
A '''cigarra''', also '''cigar''' or '''cigarillo''', was a mild narcotic that could be ignited and smoked for the purposes of relaxation.

Cigarras were kept in humidors,<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> and were extremely popular in [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] districts and drinking establishments.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Niles Ferrier]] were known to be avid cigarra smokers. 

Aficionados could sometimes distinguish between different varieties by the scent of their smoke. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], while at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] shipyard, Lando Calrissian was able to identify the smell of [[Carababba tabac|carababba]] [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]] with [[armudu spice]] on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]'s clothing, meaning that the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had recently been in close proximity to someone smoking a carababba cigarra. 

Knowing that ship thief Niles Ferrier was a frequent user of this variety, Calrissian feared that he may be attempting to steal from the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] currently docked at the shipyard. His suspicions proved correct when Skywalker used Force memory enhancements to recall that Ferrier was heading towards a lesser used corridor. Skywalker later used used [[Force smell]] to track Ferrier by his cigarra smoke.

Other cigarra smokers included [[Security Chief's Second|Senior Second]] [[Grubber Vapps]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]]<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> and his superior [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==Varieties==
One type of cigarra used [[Carababba tabac|carababba]] [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]]. On [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], cigarras were made from [[rashallo]] leaves. [[Shento cigar]]s were another brand. [[Marcan herb/Legends|Marcan herb]] was normally smoked through a [[Hookah pipe/Legends|hookah pipe]] but could also be smoked in a cigarra. [[Savorium herb]] could be eaten, or smoked in a cigarra, causing a mild euphoria.
